label: D2 after choosing a1 and landing in S2 (a1 rare transition), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (DELAY_2) and only when the last-action input is a1. It never fires on D1 or GO, or after a2. Most of the mass (87%) comes from a1 followed by a rare transition into S2, and all of the top activations (~1.0) are of that kind. a1 followed by common S1 gives weak activations (~0.1-0.3), mostly when the previous trial was rewarded. The feature also depends strongly on how far into the episode the trial is: it is silent before trial ~30, peaks at trials 60-89 and drops off again at 90-99, so it fires mainly when good=S1 and value is mid-range (5.2-7.5). a1->S2 alone gives F1 0.37 and mass recall 0.87. Restricting to episode trials 50-89 raises F1 to 0.55 with mass recall 0.79. Adding prev_reward==1 makes it more precise but loses recall, so it does not help F1. Even within the predicate, many a1->S2 D2 steps stay silent, so recall and precision are both incomplete. Every variable used is observed at D2.
